scope: unweighted bayes_iteration/BayesPlus1 on variation shard 1. 3D Bayesian phi_h, 452 fitted cells, Q2-y 1-17. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication.
start_mode: manual. Spline B windows are tight (median width 0.020, 945 of 1390 narrower than 0.05), so --use_spline_init was not used. Changed bins are in refine_init.py, a copy of nominal_init.py.
changed: Initial run_shard was not treated as finished. 14 bins were trapped by a small first-pass moment start: the second pass only moves a parameter halfway, so A(1+B cos phi+C cos 2phi) was too flat. Starts were moved to the histogram cosine and limits that excluded it were widened in refine_init.py. Remade Q2-y 1 2 3 5 7 10 11 13 14 15 with --unfolding_3D --fit_corrections Bayesian --fit_error_source histogram --fit_init_file, no pass cap and no chi-squared stop. All 14 improved. Worst (3,16) 15.90 to 1.41. Other cells in those Q2-y bins did not move, and unselected Q2-y bins are unchanged. JSON still has 452 cells. The shared manual initializer and the universal spline file were not edited.
left_bins: No 5D family, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Histogram shapes that disagree with a neighbor were kept, including (13,10) B -0.358 beside neighbor -0.013; (15,15) B -0.332 beside neighbor -0.013; (3,24) B -0.313 beside neighbor -0.032; (11,20) B -0.294 beside neighbor -0.033.
unresolved: The best three-parameter curve still misses the histogram in (1,7) 5.11, (1,32) 5.93, (12,24) 4.60. Further guide changes do not help those bins. Empty histograms stay N/A and are not zeroes.
